title: Large Language Models: A Plain-Language Overview for Engineers
abstract: arXiv:2610.34585v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are neural networks trained on huge text collections to generate text by predicting what comes next. Engineers using ChatGPT and other generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools need a clear picture of what training changes and prompts add. The article starts with the Transformer, which connects words in context, and pre-training, where models learn to predict text. It then explains how fine-tuning adapts models to requests, with reinforcement learning from human feedback using human answer rankings. Next, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supplies documents, while chain-of-thought prompting encourages intermediate steps and agents use tools. FlashAttention lowers training and running costs by reducing data movement during attention; quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) saves fine-tuning memory. translated_title: 大语言模型：面向工程师的通俗概述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）是在海量文本集合上训练的神经网络，通过预测下一个词来生成文本。使用ChatGPT及其他生成式人工智能（AI）工具的工程师需要清楚地了解训练改变了什么、提示词又带来了什么。本文从Transformer（在上下文中连接词语的架构）和预训练（模型学习预测文本）讲起，接着解释微调如何使模型适应各类请求，以及利用人类答案排序进行的基于人类反馈的强化学习。随后介绍了检索增强生成（RAG）为模型提供文档，思维链提示鼓励模型进行中间推理步骤，以及智能体使用工具。FlashAttention通过减少注意力计算中的数据搬运来降低训练与运行成本；量化低秩适配（QLoRA）则节省微调所需的内存。读者还将获得一张生命周期图，以及比较各种方法及其局限性的表格，并附有一份用于评判的简短清单。
tldr: 本文以通俗语言为工程师系统梳理了大语言模型从Transformer、预训练、微调到RAG、思维链、智能体及FlashAttention、QLoRA等核心技术的原理与局限。
en_tdlr: A plain-language overview for engineers covering LLM core techniques, from Transformers, pre-training, and fine-tuning to RAG, chain-of-thought prompting, agents, FlashAttention, and QLoRA, along with their limitations.
